item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02730","case1_error":"Omits the 20% primer discount, charging full price instead.","case2_error":"Subtracts two practice nights as two homework hours and excludes weekend nights from the available nights.","reason":"Ignoring a price discount differs from reducing required workload and miscounting available nights.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02731","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage before dividing by coverage, incorrectly leaving the area value as the gallon count.","case2_error":"Evaluates 2,250,000 × $0.02 as $450,000 instead of $45,000.","reason":"The first uses an erroneous conversion relation; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02732","case1_error":"Interprets the ambiguous 'triple the number of T-shirts' as triple the original nine, producing a negative missing count.","case2_error":"Uses four 30-minute intervals per hour instead of two.","reason":"The first question leaves the tripling comparison materially ambiguous; the second clearly uses an incorrect time conversion.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02733","case1_error":"Treats 70% cheaper as costing 70% of the original price instead of 30%.","case2_error":"Uses the 40 good-soil acres again for clay-rich soil, which occupies only 20 acres.","reason":"Confusing a discount with the remaining price differs from assigning one category's acreage to another.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02734","case1_error":"Evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final 6000 after correctly stating initial population plus ten times that population; the formula yields 5500.","reason":"The first explicitly miscalculates a written expression; the second supplies an incorrect final number without showing its numerical calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
